name: tidy-roboports
title: Tidy Roboports
author: Philipp Gatzka
description: Roboports keep their surroundings tidy. Hover over a roboport to see how much debris (items on the ground, trees, rocks, cliffs) is in its construction range. Each roboport marks that debris for deconstruction one piece at a time, so robots clear the area gradually; a map setting raises how many pieces may be marked at once (0 turns it off). Debris robots cannot remove is skipped, and roboports without full power pause.
